- Added a teleporter conveyor, teleporting objects on 10 cells into another conveyor or container (the conveyor consumes 20 energy to teleport an item)

- For the production of items on the automatic workbench, place the required components in its container (for the production of 1 item requires 20 energy)

- For the repair of buildings you need to use the item-building of the same type for this building

notes.title: Update 0.6 States
notes.content:
- Added state
- Added new building "Castle"
- If the sector has the status of village or above, then in this sector you can create a state
- On the territory of the state, actions are limited for players who are not citizens of this state
- The state is destroyed if the private territory in the sector becomes less than 1640 cells

- You can create a state in the "Castle" sector
- A player can have only one state
- Creating a state is possible if the player’s sector has the largest private area
- The player who created the state is given the status of "Ruler"
- Other players in the "Castle" can make an application for citizenship
- The application for citizenship can be submitted only by players whose private territory is in the state sector
- A player can be a citizen of only one state
- The player has the opportunity to leave the state in any status other than the ruler

Citizens' statuses:

Citizen - Basic actions are available in the state.
Freeman - Can take citizens to the state. Cannot be deprived of citizenship.
Manager - May appoint honorary citizens. May deprive of citizenship.
Ruler - All Functions Available

- When a state is created, it is assigned a random name
- You can change the name of the state in the "Castle" for 500 000 GC
- In the "Castle" is possible to see the rating of citizens (benefit to the state)

- Added state ratings
- State map added on map
- Added entries in the chronicle of the creation and deletion of states

Additional changes:

- When moving the altar, if the distance between your altars becomes less than 500 cells, the altar is destroyed
- Disabled resource extraction for seeds in the active slot
- Added destruction of private territories cut off from the altar


The following updates are planned:

- Add extension of the state territory to neighboring sectors
- Add a state transfer function for the Ruler
- Virtual containers and auctions for citizens of states
- State technologies

- Agility allows you to evade the melee attack
- Intelligence limits the use of advanced weapons
- In the description of weapons, the required level of intelligence is added
- Bleed Intelligence is only available from level 10
- Luck increases the probability of critical damage, reduces the likelihood of tool wear, reduces the likelihood of wear of workbenches, reduces the likelihood of breakage during repair, reduces the likelihood of breakage during modification, reduces the likelihood of attack by small animals
- Luck fortune is only available from level 50
